review_description: Quote was easy to understand and clearly laid out what I was getting. All applications and sign ups to various grants/synergy/Western Power were managed efficiently and it was clear when i needed to do anything. Install job was great - the guys got right to work, explained where everything would go and helped me get the app sorted on my phone. Everything is working well and i have recommended to friends - the whole process was easy and efficient.

I initially thought blackout protection was included in my quote, but it turned out to be listed as an optional extra. This was a good reminder for me to read quotes more carefully and not assume details based on conversations with a sales representative. There was also a mix-up because the battery couldn’t be installed under the old inverter, and relocating the inverter added an extra $600 cost. Since this wasn’t in the original quote, Sunterra agreed to split the relocation cost with me. I’m happy with the outcome because the battery is now in a better location, and I understand the work involved in moving the inverter.The installation team was very knowledgeable. Once we clarified what I had signed up for, they were excellent—friendly, professional, and their workmanship was of high quality. There was a slight delay in installation due to moving the inverter, but they worked around our availability.During the process of adjusting the power meter box to install the battery, the bedroom fan and bathroom light stopped working. The team quickly fixed the issue, which was caused by my very old meter box and poor wiring.Finally, the team took the time to show me how the new battery works and walked me through the mobile app.

Previous experience with Sunterra provided a high level of confidence in choosing the company for installation of the battery. Initial quoting was provided in a timely manner and was backed up with useful information on the system and its components. Following announcement of the federal scheme a long period of inactivity was experienced. After re-establishing contact, it was advised that some technical aspects had been revised and changes mandated under the rebate scheme conditions. These revisions resulted in a technically superior system with little impact on the initial quote.Approval from the regulators was organised mainly by the company with one interaction required of the buyer. Then came another long waiting period for installation. After an installation date was set, the date was changed on three occasions.Enter the long-awaited arrival of the installation team and all was forgiven. The team was professional and technically experience and competent. Importantly, the team leader engaged openly with the owner and was generous with information and advice and had no problem coping with an interested onlooker following every move. In keeping with the manner in which the installation was conducted, the site was left impeccably tidy with all rubbish removed. It was worth the wait!

Firstly, Sunterra installed my solar panels several years ago, & I found that an overall positive experience - product has been good, service was reasonable & the price was very competitive.So fast forward to second half of 2025, & I wanted to give Sunterra the first option at setting me up with a solar battery post-Govt subsidies. The quoting process was very serviceable & friendly, received good advice & options, & - after just checking around different quotes to get the lay of the land - I was happy to proceed.That's when the process became worse. So after the agreement & go ahead, I heard nothing for about a month. I followed up, & was told I would have someone contact me to arrange an install date. Another 3 weeks passed...a slightly perturbed email went in to the guy who quoted me, who obviously cracked the whip & I got myself an install date.No pre-installation site inspection. That was done by an email with a couple of photos. I recognise this mightn't be an issue for many, but I had a small unique outdoor challenge in regards to locating the battery, & although I got what was a tacit "okay" from their office via email, on the day of install the installers arrived with a "we can't put it there" (it was an issue of concrete pads & sufficient wall space). The installers essentially watched me scramble to come up with a solution. That was a good little indicator of the customer service to come.Install occurs - that's fine. System looks okay to my uneducated eye. Was happy to have got it set up where I wanted it set up. Then one of the installers tried to get me set up with the Shine ap so I could see what was happening with the battery. A few Wifi issues, a few limitations of the ap - the installer is getting frustrated, assures me that once connection with our router is established the ap process itself is a piece of cake. I'm not so confident but I'm reasonably tech-savy - how hard can it be right? Well....The Ap installation & set up is a bloody nightmare. Requests for customer service go unanswered or fobbed off - I get told someone is coming out on a Tuesday afternoon to run me through everything, so I get home from work early afternoon, then get a message saying they're not able to attend. The following Friday I am at work & get a message saying we're coming around now...I tell them Im not actually there....but they go around anyway & end up talking to my 15 year old son which is not helpful. But hey, at least they can say they went around & tried, right?Oh, & then I get the bill and some pressure to pay - while they've charged me for concrete sheeting that they never installed. Managed to get that forted at least - by simply not paying. Then, frankly, my stress levels with this company just became too much & I want them out of my life.So all in all, I have an ap which gives me about 40% of the information I would expect to be able to access about my battery. The solar battery appears to be working okay. I fear having a need to access customer service or - heaven forbid - anything relating to warranty.Overall, Sunterra were the cheapest option when it came to getting a solar battery installed. I think the battery itself is okay - appears to be working quite well. But the Ap you use with it isn't fantastic, at all. And the customer service I experienced with Sunterra is simply the worst I have ever experienced.I do wish I had spent a couple of thousand more to have a company I would feel positive and confident in recontacting for help or advice. And a better Ap.

Landon and his team fully delivered on expectations.Despite complicating changes and delays from the state government, they adapted, effectively communicated progress and finally delivered.Installation though less than staight-forward was professionally completed.Overall - Outstanding.

Having installed offgrid solar myself in the past, Ii tend to give solar companies a hard time as I know what i want and just want options, specs and prices. Dean from Sunterra is awesome, providing all the info I requested and prices in his first response to me. He also stated any unknowns but explained what he thought and got back to me once he had the info available.The system price was great, comms have been awesome and the installers were brilliant :)
All good. We’re very happy with Sunterra, very helpful, the installer very thorough and helpful.

The salespeople at Sunterra were very polite and knowledgeable and explained clearly the system we were getting. The installers arrived on time and introduced themselves and ‘got on’ with the job expertly. They were very friendly and answered any questions we had - I would recommend them to anyone who was looking at a solar install. They assisted in setting up my phone and explained how it worked and what to look for, the connection was taken care of by them and all was working before they left. Our property was left in a clean and tidy state and I would recommend Sunterra.

The application through installation process was smooth and simple. Landon handled all my queries and the rebate applications well. The installers arrived early and finished ahead of schedule. The system is connected, working well and the app is a very handy and informative dashboard. I'm almost looking forward to my next bill to see the benefits!

I had an excellent experience from start to finish! Hakem handled the sales and quoting process and was absolutely fantastic — professional, patient, and transparent. He took the time to explain all my options clearly and made sure I got the best setup for my needs without any pressure.The installation team, led by Jun with his two team members, did an amazing job as well. They arrived right on time, were polite, tidy, and very efficient. The work was done to a high standard, and they left everything clean and perfectly organised once they finished.Customer service was top-notch too — they handled the grid connection and made sure everything was set up properly. Jun even walked me through how to use the charger and made sure I was comfortable with everything before they left.Overall, I couldn’t be happier with the whole experience. Big thanks to Hakem and Jun’s team — highly professional, friendly, and reliable from start to finish. I’d definitely recommend them to anyone!
Great customer service as well as the installation .Professionally done. Overall from the quoting to the final installation all done in a timely manner.

Thankyou Sunterra and especially you Parker for seamlessly organising our solar job.The guys did an awsome job with the install todayThe crew were polite and worked hard and harmonious together all day without a breakA better than expected result in record time and at a very competitive price.Yet another quality install for us by Sunterra and its quality contractors.We have and will continue to recommend Suntera as the first phone call if anyone is wanting to go solar.Good job Parker.Your organisation was very good and your instructions and your information was clear and spot on.It would be appreciated if this PAT on the back was also conveyed to the installation team that installed our solar today.Thanks againBrenton

Had my solar system installed today. The sales process was quick and easy with all questions answered and explained.  The team came on time and did a fantastic job with the installation. The team leader walked us through the system with patience before they left. We would definitely recommend having your battery system with this company. Well done Sunterra!!

Right from the beginning of the sales enquiry, we found the sales specialist, to be polite and patiently responded to the queries we had on the solar system with the batteries. He's gone through with the rebates we are entitled for and explained the complete process in detail. The order was installed in 2 phases and both the times, the service team had installed the solar panels and later on the batteries much before the time that was estimated. The workmanship was apt and the installation team were immaculate in getting their work done. The communication was excellent prior installation with respect to grid connection. They explained in detail the functioning of battery charging and the app which they got us installed was perfect with the relevant information. The entire team from salesman to service team were 5-star. Thanks to Sunterra for their awesome service.

Absolutley no complaints, fitted my system last year and added extra batteries yesterday, always clean tidy tradies, (sorry about the over friendly dog.) Customer service from sales thru to after care is on point. Would highly recommend

The salesperson was very knowledgeable and answered all my questions. I wouldn’t say he was pushy.The installers and electrician were very polite and professional when they turned up at your property and set up the wifi accordingly.Definitely recommend
All organised, efficient and quick to get it sorted on our new build. Very quick to answer emails and competitive pricing
Smooth sailing from start to finish. Installation was great customer service was also great. Would certainly recommend them to family and friends.

Quoting process was super easy. Price was great.Installation was very quick and the installers were very polite and friendly. I was shown how to download and use the app.Customer service was also quick to answer any questions I had.Would recommend!

So sales and quoting went fine. Initially got quotes for a 5kw because that would of been sufficient, and kept us with feed in tarrif however decided couldn't go wrong with just jumping to an 8kw so that way as the family grows we knew we were covered.Sunterra handled the application and approvals so that way easy.They honestly would have gotten 5 stars because they were just fantastically priced with good quality products but the install let us down a little.We had to get them to come back to fix 3 things1) line up of the panels so they all vertically were in line and looked neater2) run the cables under a nearby eave instead of over the top of our roof so the birds stopped attacking it, and get it out of full time sun into full time shade.3) one bracket was loose and the panel was sloping off slightly- they came back and fixed this.There was a bit of delayed communication from our "aftercare" lady with us communicating this issue, her replying with an explanation for one thing but not addressing the other issues. We replied specifying that we would in fact like these issues fixed and it took about 2 weeks but then the installers got in touch with a date to come back and address our issues.Now it all looks neat and tidy and is working great.Photos of the issues that they then came and fixed up.

Quote was fast , sales were great to deal with answering all questions, guys installing were very good ,explained everything also showing how the app works , and they managed to have it installed in 1week from initial quote very happy.

Insulation was neat and tidy, installers were extremely polite and did a great job. Had to wait a week after start for finish due to long weekend unfortunately but other than that it was seamless. Very happy with outcome.
Decent equipment installed on time, at reasonable cost by polite & friendly tech's - Pleased so far! Would recommend.

Having requested a number of quotes for battery systems from different solar companies Sunterra provided a product at a price no others could match.I decided on a 3-phase 5kw Growatt system with 5kw battery and 9.2kw Jinko panels.Dean and I selected the best options available for roof fitment (most north and some west) and he even kept emailing me back variations on his days off.No big deposit was requested and I was kept up-to-date throughout the regulatory application process via emails.Installation took a big longer than planned, with a second visit required, however I would much rather this than to rush an install and have problems later like leaks etc. The head technician was awesome and even helped me with the cover as the inverter/battery were also installed outside at my request. So very happy.My in-laws arrived from overseas for 1 month visit 2 days after install was completed and with our 3 kids we currently have 7 ppl in the house. Our small battery has got us through the late afternoons, nights and early mornings fine so far, and that’s with an electric (heat pump) water heater.We’re averaging around 46kw solar production per day so getting at least enough back to cover our daily service charge for the minuscule amount WP pay us for feed-in kw’s.Early days yet for the system so we’ll see how we’re looking a year down the track. May look at another 5kw battery down the line.5-stars for Sunterra!

Had a wonderful experience and worth recommending to anyone looking for solarSpecial thanks to Parker who not only gave me quote which was really competitive but also helped me selecting right product that can fulfill my needs/requirements.

Dealing with Sunterra Solar has been an outstanding experience from start to finish. The entire process, from the initial consultation to installation and even after-sales service, has been exceptional.Hakim, the Sales Manager, was fantastic. He is extremely knowledgeable and provided a tailored quote over the phone based on my energy consumption. His expertise and understanding of the products ensured I received the best solution at a very competitive price, taking advantage of their latest offers. His professionalism and technical insight were truly impressive.I opted for an 10kW system paired with a Fronius inverter. The team, including Zac, Dylan, and Jun, went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect, delivering exceptional workmanship.I highly recommend Sunterra if you are looking for a professional job to be done smoothly and professionally.

I recently had a 6.6kW solar system installed by Sunterra Solar, and I couldn't be happier with the entire process! The system includes sleek all-black Jinko panels and a reliable Growatt inverter, both of which not only perform exceptionally well but also look fantastic. The panels blend beautifully with my roof, and the inverter is compact and impressive in design.A big shoutout to the installation team – Zac, Dillon, and Jun – who were incredibly professional. They arrived right on time, worked efficiently, and left the roof spotless after the installation. It's clear they take great pride in their work, and it shows.A special thanks goes to Hakim, the Sales Engineer, who guided me through understanding the system’s performance and tailored recommendations to meet my energy needs. His expertise and patience made the decision-making process smooth and stress-free.I highly recommend Sunterra Solar to all my friends and family. If you're looking for a professional, customer-focused team to handle your solar installation, look no further!
Asked for a quote for solar, got a response quickly, made the booked and installation happened within week. Friendly installation team, who got us solar before Christmas.

Second time using Sunterra with an higher capacity system installed as part of a major renovation.  Process was seamless from start to finish.  Quotation process with Parker was simple and I was kept informed in the lead up to the install.Seb and his team arrived on time, did a first rate job and did not leave any mess.Seb in particular went above and beyond the call of duty with follow up service and minor trouble shooting with the monitoring app,I highly recommend this company.\

Sunterra met the brief regarding the equipment they used in their solar systems. Hakim guided me through the process required to get the installation under way (government rebate and other paperwork) and then the installers arrived. Wow! What a team. In two afternoons the my old system was removed and the new one installed including a complete switchboard overhaul. The site was left spotless and I couldn’t be happier. I highly recommend Sunterra.

Planning and installation went well.Jacob and the team were very pleasant.Only needed 3 tiles to replace and placed my old solar in the yard as l requested.The app shows the impressive power generation and the 5kWh battery is supplying my night time use with little grid requirement at present.Very pleased with the service.

From the  very start of any inquiry by me Hakim was pleasant, knowledgeable and very patient.  The quotation was prompt with explanation of process to come.  The installation process lived up to expectations and were so smooth it was amazing.  To Mo and Michael thank you so much for the time you gave in ensuring I was part of a joint involvement which I really appreciated.   Congratulations to you all at Sunterra , I sing your praises.   Tony

His attention to detail and proactive communication kept me informed at every stage, which made a world of difference. I highly recommend Sunterra for their top-notch service and dedication to customer satisfaction!
I have had a great experience from the beginning.  Installation neat, efficient and professional.  Very satisfied with Sunterra, would use them again.

Stay away from Sunterra Solar, multiple problems that Sunterra cannot fix. Keep guessing trying to fix my system, refusing to abide by Consumer Law.My system is constantly going offline, circuits that are meant to be on backup go offline even with the grid connected and no power outage.Terrible installers, destroyed my property. Scratched my gutters which I was only offered $500 in compensation. Destroyed by brickwork and installed crooked covers for the inverter and batteries. Worst workmanship I have ever seen.Will see this company in court.

Was recommended to Sunterra by a family. Member told me to get a quote. We are just received a quote from another company and so I decided oh well I’ll go ahead and try and see what Sonterra can do for us. We were very happy. The quote was done over the phone. The service was friendly, very thorough explained everything to us and I could not believe the difference in price for exactly the same product as I compared the quotes we went with Sunterra because we saved money. The service was fantastic. I can’t remember the installers name. We can’t say enough about the service thank you to Landon and everyone else in the office and the installers great job

The process was seamless from start to finish. Other than waiting a few weeks which is quite understandable in the current climate, we were very satisfied with everything. The installers were efficient, tidy with great attention to detail. We extremely delighted with the finished product.

Unlike many other providers they listened to our needs and tailored a product accordingly.Great service commencing with Landon through to the installation by Sebastian and his team along with the follow up services to arrange the meter change and related paperworkWe highly recommend their services

Referred to Sunterra by a friend who gave me Dean's contact details. No pressure sales but a friendly service. Dean provided a quote via email which allowed me to check out the opposition after which the quote was very reasonable. Also did my research on the quality of the product and warranty claims which everybody said was seamless. When you spend money like this you want to ensure that back up is provided. My investigations confirmed warranties and product to be one of the best.I have since referred another friend to Dean.

Mathew, Josh and Mosh were some of the nicest people i have ever met, from arrival to completion they conducted themselves professionally and with courtesy  throughout the day and left me with a very satisfying feeling that I had chosen the right people.

The whole process from getting a quote to installation has been a great experience.  Hakim from sales was excellent, he was not pushy, answered my questions with detail. there was a small deposit and the rest was paid after installation.The installation was neat and tidy. Installer was polite, tidy and punctual.I would recommend Sunterra.
Dean has been wonderful to deal with, best value for money, professional installation team with attention to details & seamless finish, highly recommended

Sales was easy and after several quotes the choice was already made.No problem with installation team they were excellent, communication regarding the time and day was a bit confusing from the office.I have already used the customer service due to damage from a big storm, the technician came promtly.

The knowledge and service from the team at Sunterra was great. All went smoothly from quote to installation and follow up, and the equipment is working well. Very reasonably priced - would definitely recommend these guys.

Sales/Quoting - no pressure to get the largest system, they do listen.Install - the installation team was on time friendly and clean and tidy.Customer Service - Exceptional!Sunterra has been the most helpful and understanding Solar company. They have listened and understood my needs. They were the only company that did not try to pressure me into buying a 6 to 12 KW system.The install went ahead without any complications and the installation team was friendly and knowledgeable.Overall, I would highly recommend Sunterra to anyone!Sunterra will design the system to your needs and not just try to sell you large off the shelf system !

Hakim contacted us to advise of a special offer on additional batteries for our 18 month old system. We enquired and Hakim promptly answered our questions and provided a written quote. The batteries were provided and installed earlier than expected. Again the installation was professional and efficient (thanks Matthew) a system check was provided at no extra charge. The result has been surprising with a significant reduction in daily grid consumption as the 2 new batteries came on-line. I again commend Hakim and the Sunterra team and will be looking to add 2 further batteries when there is next a special offer.

Our sales agent Landon had fantastic customer service ,was very direct and clear on pricing. He made the process so easy. The installation team were just as great, they helped us understand the system. Very happy with the upgraded system and overall customer service from the Sunterra team.

Sunterra have been amazing from the initial discussions with Landon Bekovs in order to obtain a quote to replace my existing system, along with follow up chats relating to pricing, product requirements and the best system to meet my requirements.Sunterra not only offered the best price compared with similar systems that I have been quoted, they were also wonderful through the post sale and install process including the removal and disposal of my old system.It only took around about two weeks from deposit being paid to the install of the new system, brilliant.On the day of install the installers attended on time and the work was completed to a high standard, they were polite and professional.Thank you Sunterra, whom I highly recommend to anyone looking at getting or replacing a solar system.  Finally thank you Landon for all of your assistance and support and making this such an easy process.
Got a great solar system including batteries installed with no fuss and good workmanship. Very satisfied and enjoying not paying for electricity!
Easy nice and friendly staff , Landon provides great customer service. Highly recommended to everyone.
The whole experience was great, sales informative, quick to respond and helpful, installation was quick, neat and the installers friendly. I would recommend Sunterra to anyone

We can highly recommend Sunterra for a residential solar system.  From the very start, they (Landon) were very responsive and easy to deal with, and their quote was very competitive.Turnaround from acceptance of quote to installation was very prompt (approximately 2 ½ weeks).When it came to arranging the installation, communication was excellent.  The installation guys turned up on time and were friendly and informative, keeping us updated all the way through the installation.  The guys were also very professional and left everything clean and tidy.Unfortunately, due to inclement weather, the installation was unable to be completed in one day, and necessitated the guys returning on a second day where the weather was conducive to installing the panels to the roof of our two storey house.Once installation was complete, we were given a full walk through of the system, along with instructions on how to download the app to monitor our system's performance.Any questions we had were answered promptly, and as others have said in their reviews, at no time did we feel there was any sales pressure.Highly recommended.
The quotation was quick, installation done on time per the schedule .

Great company to deal with and install was 110% and being a Electrical Contractor myself I can verify the work is quality with lots of extras that others don't do or supply in the price.Don't waste your time with anyone else use Sunterra

Landon was very helpful initially and helped us through the initial stages.  Tevita, James and Sam installed the solar system and were on time and very professional during the day.  All questions were answered and they were very helpful in showing me how to use the app and how the system works etc.Very happy with the whole process, thank you boys.
Working with Landon and the team, everything was smooth and easy. From constant communication, friendly advice and quick install.

I recently had a 6.6 kWh solar panel system installed by Sunterra, and I couldn't be happier with the experience. Amar Hakim, our sales representative, was incredibly helpful and provided all the necessary details to help us make an informed decision. The entire process, from consultation to installation, was seamless. The installation team was professional and efficient, ensuring everything was set up perfectly. I highly recommend Sunterra for anyone considering solar panels. Excellent service and quality work!
Sales and quoting process is very smoothThe installation is smooth, it takes two daysThe customer services are very supportive
Excellent start to finish fast and professional installation installed one week after ordering

Working with Landon and the team at Sunterra was an easy experience with upgrading my system, quoting, communication and final installation. Would highly recommend using Sunterra if you want a stress free experience.

We recently had a 10.45kw system installed and the process was easy, smooth and went without a problem.The sales team didn't call every day to get us to sign up and they were extremely helpful with our questions and requests.The team Tevita & Jamie did a great installation and were polite, tidy and punctual.I highly recommend the team at Sunterra.
Sales process was good. The installation was punctual and the job was done well within the time frame.We received good customer service and the grid connection was installed.
The whole process was seamless we received exactly what we wanted and within a timely manner.

The quoting process with Hakim was efficient and concise. He tailored the solution perfectly to my needs and offered valuable advice based on my usage patterns.Zac's installation work was exceptional, and Hakim demonstrated commendable dedication by ensuring thorough follow-up after the installation.Saif delivered top-notch customer service, guiding me through the app installation process and providing a detailed walk through of how to utilize the service effectively.Overall, Sunterra delivered a cost-effective solar system that met my needs, accompanied by a first-rate installation and service experience.

Sunterra came as a referral from a friend who has had the system for a few years. I prefer using products and companies that family and friends have used before as their reviews are usually accurate. On-line reviews are also very helpful.I was impressed with the initial contact, the promptness and detail of the quote, and the guidance provided.Whilst the whole process took several months, Sunterra kept me updated with approval progress etc. so I didn't feel like I was being forgotten. They did say it would take time, and my friend also said it does take time for approvals etc.The installation team was polite and professional, and understanding to my specific needs on the day. The guy who showed me how the system operates and how to use the App was also very professional and took his time to go through everything with me.The after sales information was amazing, from the accounts team through to warranty information to customer service information should we ever need to call for assistance in the future.

The quoting process with Sunterra and Graham was by far the best and most responsive of all the quotes we received. He was amazing at making sure all my questions were answered and seemed knowledgeable and very helpful.Unfortunately the next stage of the process was where the Sunterra let themselves down. July 2023 was when we first approached Sunterra and finally agreed in September 2023. Things progressed quickly then an install date was set with a third party contractor. We have a steep colorbond roof with multiple sections (35 degrees to which some people wouldn't even install on) and I think this played a part in the issues.- 1st install attempt - weather delay as it was raining. The problem was they didn't tell me this until after midday when they were due at 7am.- 2nd install attempt - weeks later - excuse made by 3rd party contractor but refused to reschedule. 2 more weeks went by with no contact whatsoever. I threatened to pull the pin on the job. Was then asked if 'there was a way to get panels onto my roof?' A question I was shocked by.Another week went by before an in house installer came to measure and review (the first time anyone had actually been to the house). Eventually a plan was made a month or so after the original installation date with their in house installers.The 3rd party installers were unreliable and never turned up once. Do not use their 3rd party installers if you can avoid it.Final installation date was agreed in mid November 2023. Zac was great and the 2 day install went pretty smoothly. We found out later that the staging part of my roof (a flatter walkway covered section) was damaged by the installers not walking on the rivets. Hence the 'pretty smoothly'.We discussed several options for the wiring and backup circuits and implemented them. Ended up with almost all power circuits connected to the EPS which is great but it turns out you can't keep the EPS switch on all the time with a Microwave connected as there is an amp limit running through the battery. A slight inconvenience but overall not a deal breaker. SO we run with Grid mode on, meaning if the power goes out we have to switch back on or deal with the microwave cutting off the EPS randomly while we have full grid power available.After installation all of the connections, inspection and paper work was done really quickly (within a week) and we were away. Great customer service from that perspective.Then we found the damage, 7-8 sheets of colorbond was dinted and folded. Customer service eventually organised 2 tradies through Hi Pages to quote. This process was almost entirely managed by us. They had no idea what the job was when they rocked up. Overall it all got fixed, but the guy that ended up doing it tried to tell me they don't make my colour sheets any more so he got the 'closest too it' but he clearly got the colour wrong. Couldn't be bothered changing and arguing so left it at that. This colour difference was no fault of Sunterra, but they could at least have trusted local tradies they use, not randoms off Hi Pages.Overall Sunterra did a good job, were let down by some contractors and silly mistakes but I am happy with the system working as it should.Would I recommend them, I would, but you need to be switched on to manage the process.

I got 5 quotes in Adelaide and Sunterra was the 2nd lowest but $1000 dearer than the lowest and $2700 cheaper than the next. I chose them initially because reviews were quite good and they provided a very detailed quote. They were professional from that point on and answered any questions. The installers took their time to plan panel location, then installed the system with no shortcuts. I am an electrician myself and was very happy. 2 months later everything is working how it should. Yes, I would recommend them.
Great service and product. Quick to respond to queries and follow up minor issue with inverter comm’s setting issue. Highly recommend Sunterra.

All was good.I had expected supplier to agree installation plan with me well before the day of installation.I liked the installation completed in under 3 hours by a team of 5.Its been a month and it has not generated even once 6.6kw or 5kw power even in full sun, so value for money is not 5 star.

The company was very quick to respond to enquiries. The process was easy and smooth - straightforward. Installation was right on time, tidy and very polite installers.All systems hooked up and wi-fi programming set up as well.

From obtaining quotes, followup inquires by ourselves the service and installation has been excellent. All inquiries were answered promptly and clearly - thank you Dean.The office kept us updated from lodgement of application with Synergy, their  response and proposed installation date to confirm date and time of arrival. The guys arrived on time and had installation completed and functioning in about 4-4 1/2 hours. They knew their job and just got it done with no fuss. Both guys very polite, were tidy and removed from site all waste. Some time was spent with us to get linked to the website to start monitoring. Thank you Kieran and offsider.The system has been pumping out the energy all week with no issues. We're looking forward to reduced power bills and eagerly await battery backup systems to become more accessible.Our only gripe with the system is the new Gen 5 plus Fronius Symo inverter fan is quite noisy.
